thread:
Priya: Quick sync — we need a rollout plan for the EU model switch next week. Proposal: start with a 20% canary in eu-west-1, expand to 100% over 48h conditional on errors <0.5% and median latency <200ms. Need flag strategy, canary selection (random vs tenant-slice), and fallback rules.
Jason: I vote tenant-slice canary (by account cohort). Random sampling masks per-tenant regressions. Also include an enterprise escape hatch so paid customers can opt out.
Tom: +1 on tenant slices. Ops ask: define automated rollback gates. Suggest: if error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 400ms for 10m, trigger immediate rollback to model-v1 for the region.
Sara: Also recommend a shadow run for 5% of traffic to check ranking/regression signals without impacting users. Keep shadow for 24h and compare embeddings / rerank deltas. Need cost estimate though.
Ben: For flags, use a single toggle "eu_model_v2" with parameters: rollout_pct, per_tenant_exempt_list, shadow_pct, and warmup_window. A/B instrumentation: latency, token-cost, completion-quality (manual eval sampling), and downstream CTR.
Priya: Operational detail — can we implement header-based routing so QA can seed specific slices? e.g., set X-Redwood-Slice: canary-20 or X-Redwood-Tenant: tenant-abc. That avoids flaky randomness.
Jason: SRE: please add a lightweight health check for the variant: GET /health?variant=v2 that returns model version, kv-cache-hit-rate and recent latency percentiles. K8s probes can use that.
DeployBot: job-84421 started: creating canary routing rule and applying feature flag eu_model_v2@20%. Logs: apply-step-1 OK.
Tom: Circuit-breaker semantics: open for 30m after rollback, plus a manual override to re-enable. Also log every automated rollback to the rollout-audit index and notify #incidents.
Sara: Shadow test budget: estimate +12% GPU usage for 24h at current qps. I'll post a short cost breakdown in the doc.
Priya: Action items: 1) Priya to author rollout RFC with thresholds and canary cohorts (due EOD). 2) Tom to add circuit-breaker automation + audit logging. 3) Jason to coordinate health-check + header routing with SRE. 4) Sara to run shadow-cost calc and sample evals. 5) Ben to implement flag schema and telemetry hooks.
Ben: I'll also wire a telemetry tag so we can slice by tenant and by variant in the console.
Jason: once RFC is up, let's schedule a 30m shiproom tomorrow to sanity-check the gating logic.
Priya: Sounds good — tagging folks: @Jason @Tom @Sara @Ben. If no objections by 4pm I'll start the RFC. :thumbsup:
Tom: :thumbsup:
Sara: :+1:
Ben: ACK
